Clean a dendrometer series: breaks, dormancy, alignment, zero base

Source: R/breaks.R
dm_clean_series.Rd

The DendroMatic cleaning core. Composes, in order: dm_level_breaks() (growth-aware break leveling), dm_erase_dormancy() and dm_align_seasons() (one combined season pass, controlled by do_dormancy_gap and align_to_prev_peak), dm_rebase_zero(), and an optional re-run of treenetproc::proc_dendro_L2() on the result ('treenetproc' required only for that step). apply_breaks_and_shift() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias; output is byte-identical to the original single-function implementation (enforced by the package's toolkit-parity test).

Usage

dm_clean_series(
  df,
  brks,
  grow_start_dm = "01-05",
  grow_end_dm = "31-10",
  growth_window_days = 14,
  growth_method = c("daily_lm", "10min_lm", "daily_robust", "10min_lm_flip"),
  allow_negative_growth = FALSE,
  max_slope_day = Inf,
  max_growth_total = Inf,
  tz = "UTC",
  rerun_proc_L2 = TRUE,
  year_range = NULL,
  do_dormancy_gap = TRUE,
  align_to_prev_peak = TRUE,
  initial_clip_ts = NULL,
  final_clip_ts = NULL,
  first_year_override = NULL,
  last_year_override = NULL
)

apply_breaks_and_shift(
  df,
  brks,
  grow_start_dm = "01-05",
  grow_end_dm = "31-10",
  growth_window_days = 14,
  growth_method = c("daily_lm", "10min_lm", "daily_robust", "10min_lm_flip"),
  allow_negative_growth = FALSE,
  max_slope_day = Inf,
  max_growth_total = Inf,
  tz = "UTC",
  rerun_proc_L2 = TRUE,
  year_range = NULL,
  do_dormancy_gap = TRUE,
  align_to_prev_peak = TRUE,
  initial_clip_ts = NULL,
  final_clip_ts = NULL,
  first_year_override = NULL,
  last_year_override = NULL
)

Arguments

df

Data.frame with columns series, ts, value.

brks

Named list: series name to a list of c(start, end) timestamp pairs. A flat unnamed list of pairs is accepted for a single-series df.

grow_start_dm, grow_end_dm

Growing-season start and end as "DD-MM" strings.

growth_window_days

Window (days) used for the slope estimate and the level-shift reference search around each break.

growth_method

Slope estimation method: one of "daily_lm", "10min_lm", "daily_robust", "10min_lm_flip".

allow_negative_growth

If FALSE, negative slope estimates are clamped to zero.

max_slope_day

Cap on the slope estimate (micrometres per day).

max_growth_total

Cap on the growth extrapolation per gap (micrometres).

tz

Timezone for timestamp coercion.

rerun_proc_L2

If TRUE, re-runs proc_dendro_L2 on the cleaned data (requires 'treenetproc').

year_range

Optional year range for the attached display view.

do_dormancy_gap

If TRUE, erases inter-seasonal dormancy periods and pre-first-season data.

align_to_prev_peak

If TRUE, aligns each season's start to the prior year's maximum.

initial_clip_ts, final_clip_ts

Optional timestamps; rows outside [initial_clip_ts, final_clip_ts] are dropped before any other step.

first_year_override, last_year_override

Integers forcing the first or last growing-season year; NULL = auto-detect from data inside the growing-season window.

Value

A data.frame of the same shape as df with breaks levelled, dormancy erased, seasons aligned and each series re-based to zero (the L2 output when rerun_proc_L2 = TRUE). Carries a "dcr_view" attribute with the display view.

Details

Progress is reported both as a terminal text bar and as 'progressr' signals: wrap the call in progressr::with_progress() (or a Shiny withProgressShiny() handler) to render them elsewhere.
